author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.
Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.
These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork.
Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:
Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: Puffball Comics
title: Artist Call for Abida - Line Art Finishing Artist
content:
📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢
Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2
We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel.
What you'll be working on:
○ Finishing and refining line art / inks
○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages
○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches
○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction
You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework.
If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: Illustrators Fair / The Cartoon Museum
title: Spooky friendly illustrator required
content: Spooky friendly illustrator required! We’re in need to fill our next illustrator in residence vacancy. Are you up for an evening of on the spot illustrating? On 29 October @illustratorsfair is teaming up with @thecartoonmuseum to host an evening of SPOOKY creative fun. We need someone to join the team for the evening to: 1. Illustrate some spooky tales as our guests confess their real life ghost experiences. 2. Capture the mood of the night with some moody and expressive images. 3. Surprise us with your personal approach and unique vision. You will retain ownership of all your images but give us permission to post the outcomes across our feeds. You will receive a bursary of £180 for four hours of onsite work and two further hours to refine and format your artwork. You will be featured in a blog interview in our new and evolving Substack channel. You will be fully credited when your images are posted across our feeds. Apply ASAP! The 29th is very soon!!!! Apply by emailing us (contact in bio) including a short description of what you do and why you’re spooky. We also definitely need to see examples of your work. Deadline for applications midnight Sunday 25 October. Email: atillustratorsfair@gmail.com
